headline_findings: 60.0% of the set is classified as buildable-now in the current verified dataset.

The most common known primary auth path is OAuth 2.0, while unresolved auth rows stay visible for targeted review.
The most common non-trivial blocker is admin_setup_required, reinforcing that integration readiness is often limited by access/setup friction rather than API existence alone.
Support and Helpdesk has the highest buildable-now share in this pass at 90.0%.
The sampled verification audit measured 37.5% strict field accuracy and 51.7% correct-or-partial coverage.
Rows that remain low-confidence or flagged are preserved as review work rather than silently promoted into the final table.
